findings.evidence: The published conclusion contains the fragments “with the quotient vector-space operations of Coset equality, well-defined quotient operations...” and “in the sense of A norm on a real vector space...”. These do not state the quotient operations or normed-space convention in a usable sentence. The assigned definition directly depends on this item for its L² quotient norm; although the supplier proof’s final step shows the intended result, the published Statement remains malformed.

The definition embeds wikilinks to the real/complex normed-space definitions, realification, and complete metric space inside the Banach-space definition. The assigned sensor-law definition reaches this transitive supplier through its strongly-measurable/Banach-valued prerequisites. Under the uninterrupted-definition rule these references must follow the complete Definition.

The definition contains the title residue “construction of The quotient vector space V/W and its canonical projection” and later “the later item The Lp distance...”. These phrases leave citation/title text embedded in the Definition instead of plain mathematical wording and a following references section.

The completed probability-measure/probability-space definitions retain the title-only parentheticals “(Measures on sigma-algebras)” and “(Measure spaces)” inside the Definition, while their links are already in Definition references. These citation remnants interrupt the complete formulation.

After the formal product-sigma-algebra display, the sentence reads “generated by the measurable rectangles of Measurable rectangles in a product of measurable spaces.” The embedded title residue makes the definition paragraph malformed; the assigned Reynolds theorem uses this supplier for product measurability.

The explanatory text reads “Continuity is Continuity of a map...” and later says the integrals are finite “in Integrable real and complex functions, and their integrals.” These are malformed title substitutions within the Definition. The opening weak-convergence test-function clause remains understandable, but the published definition is not cleanly formulated.

The Statement retains title-only parentheticals “(Integer powers a^m)” and “(Series, partial sums, convergence and the sum, divergence, and the tail series)” after links were moved to Statement references. These citation remnants interrupt the formulation used for the covariance-series calculation.

The formulation retains title-only parentheticals after the canonical rational embedding, the closure characterization, and “uncountable” (the titles begin “The rationals embed densely...”, “Limit point, isolated point...” and “Finite, countably infinite...”). These citation-only fragments must be removed from the uninterrupted Statement.

The theorem Statement contains inline wikilinks to def-equinumerous, def-countable, lem-rat-positive-denominator, and def-integers. The countability claim is consumed by the assigned theorem’s rational-box measurability argument; these links interrupt the complete Statement instead of following it.

The Definition embeds wikilinks for probability kernels, probability measures, monotone convergence, stationarity, transition matrices, and weighted Dirac sums. These references interrupt the invariant/stationary-distribution definition used by the assigned Markov-chain branch.

The phi-irreducibility definition contains inline wikilinks to the measurable-space, probability-kernel, and sigma-finite-measure definitions instead of placing those links after the complete Definition.
The aperiodicity definition embeds inline wikilinks to phi-irreducibility and invariant-distribution definitions. This interrupts the complete definition used in the assigned Markov-chain regime.

The symmetric-flow definition embeds wikilinks to probability kernels, probability measures, product sigma-algebras, and the joint-law lemma within the Definition. The assigned reversible-chain branch uses this convention; links belong after the complete Definition.

The ergodicity definition includes the inline link to def-strict-and-mod-null-invariant-sigma-algebras inside its formulation. This interrupts the definition used for the shift-invariant-event hypothesis.

The definition ends with inline wikilinks to def-measure-space and def-measurable-function-between-measurable-spaces. These references interrupt the complete definition of the measure-preserving system used by the assigned shift hypothesis.

The definition retains the title-only parenthetical “(Probability measures and probability spaces)” inside its formulation, although the prerequisite link is listed under Definition references. It should be plain mathematical wording without this citation fragment.

The coefficient definition inserts the inline wikilink to def-l-p-space-as-a-quotient-by-null-functions within the definition. This interrupts the coefficient formulation used by the assigned mixing branch.

The Statement embeds wikilinks to the zero-long-run-variance lemma and mixing-coefficient definition in its final sentence. This violates the uninterrupted-statement rule for the supplier used by the assigned general stationary branch.

The six-regime MCMC statement embeds wikilinks throughout its hypotheses and conclusions (including phi-irreducibility, aperiodicity, stationarity, geometric/polynomial rates, Lp conditions, and zero variance). These links interrupt the complete statement consumed by the assigned Markov-chain branch.

The zero-variance lemma embeds a wikilink to the Lp-space definition inside its hypothesis that the process is square-integrable. The link interrupts the complete statement used by the assigned CLT supplier’s degenerate case.

coverage_note: Reviewed both assigned pages, all six assigned items, and all 40 unique direct dependency/discharge items in the batch-32 carriers; also opened the zero-variance CLT lemma and relevant transitive Banach-space suppliers. Exact source sections reviewed include Jones arXiv:math/0409112v2 §4.1 (Theorems 5, 6, 9), Geyer §§4.8.1–4.8.2, Tao §1.7 (Theorems 1.7.15 and 1.7.21), Teschl §11.6 (Lemma 11.31 and Theorem 11.32), and Terquem §6.3.1. The transitive closure beyond dependencies needed for the assigned arguments was not exhaustively audited. Some direct suppliers were opened after their consumer during the initial pass; all direct supplier statements and the relevant proofs/source passages were checked before final dispositions. No full-library or full-transitive-closure audit is claimed.
